description:
### Release v3.16.8

- **Fix Gboard 18.5.4 Keyboard Crash (VerifyError)**: Fixed a critical Dalvik/ART `VerifyError` (`Verifier rejected class com.google.android.apps.inputmethod.libs.latin5.LatinIme: register v31 has type Reference: LatinIme but expected Reference: InputMethodService`) that caused the keyboard to crash immediately upon opening on Gboard 18.5.4.
- **Correct InputMethodService Event Dispatch Hook**: Correctly rebound the `Long-Press Editing Shortcuts` input event dispatcher to `Laeut;->aw(Lacwt;)Z` (the actual InputMethodService dispatcher) instead of `LatinIme.p`, fully resolving keyboard startup crashes.
